scope: Monte Carlo uncertainty on fixed saved development cases only; no independent-scene or population coverage claim.

bootstrap.paired_across: all methods and both regimes within each case
bootstrap.case_aggregation: equal arithmetic mean of log variance ratios
bootstrap.interpretation: Approximate paired empirical bootstrap Monte Carlo uncertainty, not an exact nominal confidence guarantee. Three prespecified comparisons use the stated one-sided quantile.

integrity.interpretation: Finite Monte Carlo diagnostic; failure is an unresolved integrity warning, not proof of bias. A samepatch is deliberately excluded.
